question: What did we decide about the Phoenix facade?
summary: Client representative decided: Front facade in HPL instead of ACP.

answer.text: Client representative decided: Front facade in HPL instead of ACP.
Client approved HPL panels for the front facade.

facts.text: Decision: Front facade in HPL instead of ACP

confidence.reason: Answered from a confirmed decision with its source.

evidence.title: Phoenix client group
evidence.excerpt: Saw the HPL samples at site today. We prefer the HPL panels over ACP for the front facade even if it costs more — please go ahead and update the drawings.
evidence.author: Client representative

evidence.title: Revised quotation — facade cladding (HPL)
evidence.excerpt: As discussed, switching the front facade from ACP to HPL changes the cladding package from ₹14,80,000 to ₹24,00,000 including fixing system. Validity 30 days.
evidence.author: Facade vendor

evidence.title: Phoenix site group
evidence.excerpt: Client wants double low-E glazing on the front facade. Let us update the spec and ask Skyline for the revised cost.
evidence.author: Project lead (Phoenix)

evidence.title: Revised quote — curtain wall variation
evidence.excerpt: Attached is the revised quote for the curtain wall. The glazing change adds a variation of ₹6,10,000 over the original package. Validity 15 days.
evidence.author: Facade vendor, Skyline Facades
